name: The Bramble Queen

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

languages: Selephra can speak with any plant or mundane animal
description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

effect.description: The Bramble Queen can disguise herself to appear as any Medium humanoid, usually a beautiful elf or eladrin. A successful Insight check (opposed by the Bramble Queen’s Bluff check) pierces the disguise.

effect.description: The Bramble Queen makes up to three claws of bark and/or writhing briar attacks, in any combination.

miss.description: Half damage, and the target is pushed 2 squares.

effect.description: The Bramble Queen trades bodies with a plant ally within 10 squares. The queen and the ally swap positions, and also trade conditions or other ongoing effects.

The Bramble Queen shifts up to 8 squares, and can ignore difficult terrain and move through creatures during this shift. At any one point during the shift, the Bramble Queen can make a claws of bark or writhing briar attack.

powers.name: Unseen Briar
powers.trigger: An enemy within 4 squares leaves a square or makes a ranged or area attack.

effect.description: The Bramble Queen makes a writhing briar attack against the triggering enemy.

powers.name: Prodding Briar
powers.trigger: An ally begins its turn within 4 squares of the Bramble Queen.

effect.description: The Bramble Queen slides the ally 3 squares.
